scope: January1970 ownership and a player-controlled Iranian coercive alternative around British withdrawal

history.january1970: Sharjah administered Abu Musa under British protection; Iran maintained a competing sovereignty claim. UAE represents the Trucial emirates in this map.
history.1971_11_30: Iran landed in an agreed part of Abu Musa, leaving the rest under Sharjah civil administration. The Tunbs were occupied against the wishes of Ras al-Khaimah; these are different arrangements.
history.1971_12_01: Britain terminated the special treaty relationship.
history.1971_12_02: The United Arab Emirates federation was established.

map.tunbs_scope: The Tunbs have no separate state in this map. This operation targets Abu Musa only; no Hormuzgan or mainland coast transfer is used.

gameplay.war_goal: Native take_state_focus with generator1119; native expiry and war diplomacy apply.
gameplay.historical_distinction: This is a coercive alternate course. It does not represent the historical Abu Musa agreement as an unopposed conquest or a transfer of all three islands.
